table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	doctype = 'IS' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(h.IssueInvCode, 10))), 
	Department=DT.Name,
	Code = H.IssueInvCode,
	Type = 'Issue',
	Date=H.Date,
	UserName=U.UserName,
	AliasName=I.CustomICode,
	ItemName=I.Name,
	Batch=D.Batch,
	Expiry=D.Expiry,
	Qty=D.Qty,
	Price=D.Price, 
	Value = -(D.Price * D.Qty),
	RefNo = H.ReferenceNo
FROM
	IssueHeader H LEFT OUTER JOIN Department DT ON (H.DeptCode = DT.DeptCode),
	IssueDetail D, Item I, Users U
WHERE
	H.IssueInvCode = D.IssueInvCode AND
	DT.DeptCode IN (:ai_deptcode) AND
	H.Date >= :ad_startdate AND 
	H.Date <= :ad_enddate AND 
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	H.SalesManCode = U.UserCode
UNION ALL
SELECT 
	doctype = 'RC' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(h.ReceiptInvCode, 10))), 
	Department=DT.Name,
	Code = H.ReceiptInvCode,
	Type = 'Receipt',
	Date=H.Date, 
	UserName=U.UserName,
	AliasName=I.CustomICode,
	ItemName=I.Name,
	Batch=D.Batch,
	Expiry=D.Expiry,
	Qty=D.Qty,
	Price=D.Price,
	Value = D.Price * D.Qty,
	RefNo = H.ReferenceNo
FROM
	ReceiptHeader H 	LEFT OUTER JOIN Department DT ON (H.DeptCode = DT.DeptCode),
	ReceiptDetail D, Item I, Users U
WHERE
	H.ReceiptInvCode = D.ReceiptInvCode AND
	DT.DeptCode IN (:ai_deptcode) AND
	H.Date >= :ad_startdate AND 
	H.Date <= :ad_enddate AND 
	D.ICode = I.ICode AND
	H.SalesManCode = U.UserCode
ORDER BY
	Department,
	Date,
	Type,
	Code,
	ItemName
table.sort: department A, itemname A, aliasname A, type A, code A, date A, batch A, expiry A
